Photo 1: Another angle of a similar or same engine with intake manifold, throttle body, and wiring harness visible; plastic wrap and other engine cores in background suggest a scrapyard/parts warehouse.

No photo shows an AC compressor distinctly, no start-up video, no engine code/stamp close-up, no oil pan or underside view.
